title: Bank of England Chief Warns New AI Models Threaten Global Financial Stability
content:
Bank of England Chief Warns New AI Models Threaten Global Financial Stability 16
			
		 	
				Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey is warning that advanced "frontier" AI models could materially increase cyber risk across the global financial system by making attacks faster, cheaper, and more scalable. In a letter to G20 finance officials, he said financial firms need stronger defenses and contingency plans for simultaneous disruptions. CNBC reports:  Writing in his capacity as chair of the Financial Stability Board, an international body that coordinates policy and makes recommendations to national authorities, Bailey identified the potential impact of frontier AI -- which refers to the most advanced AI models -- on cyber risk as "the most immediate concern" for the financial system.
 
"Frontier AI may have the ability materially to alter the speed, scale and economics of cyber risk, which could undermine market confidence system-wide, especially due to highly concentrated third-party service providers," Bailey said. "Recent developments have also highlighted to me that many jurisdictions do not have the protocols in place to manage the development, release, and deployment of advanced frontier AI models, heightening risks for the financial sector and beyond," he added.
 
[...] Financial institutions and technology providers will need to improve vulnerability management, response and recovery capabilities -- "and prepare for more severe scenarios involving simultaneous disruption across multiple firms or shared technology dependencies," Bailey said. Alongside new AI models, Bailey cited "fragilities" in sovereign debt markets, the growing use of debt by investors in equity markets and stretched asset valuations, particularly AI-related investments, as among his concerns.

report.summary: 英国央行行长警告前沿AI模型或引发系统性网络风险，威胁全球金融稳定。
report.background: 随着前沿AI模型快速发展，其能力已被认为可能被恶意利用，从而改变网络攻击的速度、规模和成本。英国央行行长Andrew Bailey以金融稳定理事会（FSB）主席身份致信G20财长，明确指出此类AI模型对金融系统的网络风险是“最紧迫的担忧”。他同时指出，许多司法管辖区尚未建立管理前沿AI开发、发布和部署的协议，这放大了金融业面临的风险。这一警告发生在全球金融机构日益依赖第三方服务商、且AI相关投资估值过高的背景下，引发了关于监管框架是否跟得上技术演进的讨论。
key_points: 前沿AI模型能极大提升网络攻击的速度、规模和成本效益，可能从单个机构蔓延至整个金融系统，削弱市场信心。
金融系统高度依赖少数第三方服务商，一旦这些供应商被攻击，可能出现多家金融机构同时瘫痪的连锁反应。
许多国家缺乏针对前沿AI模型开发、发布和部署的监管协议，金融业合规与风险管理面临制度空白。
央行呼吁金融机构加强漏洞管理、应急响应和恢复能力，并提前演练多机构同时受冲击的极端场景。
除AI风险外，主权债务市场脆弱性、股市杠杆投资和AI相关资产估值过高也是当前金融稳定隐患。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，此警告意味着前沿模型的安全评估与发布监管将趋严，开发者需更重视模型滥用风险。对开发者来说，需要关注AI安全对抗技术，确保模型不被用于自动化攻击。对普通用户，金融系统可能因AI驱动的网络攻击而出现服务中断，需对账户安全保持更高警惕。监管机构之间将加速协调，推动全球统一的AI金融风险治理标准。
report.tools: 可关注对抗性鲁棒性工具如CleverHans、ART（Adversarial Robustness Toolbox），以及金融AI安全框架如FSB的监管建议。此外可关注UK AI Safety Institute和EU AI Act相关合规测试工具。
